submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on the hinge token of a strongly collocating two-part unit primed by several tokens of left context: a mid-word fragment completing a primed longer word (PERR_|NOT, File|Not, ch|itosan, calc|itonin, bacterial over|growth, was re|clad, eventually out|grow), or a function word completing a fixed frame — relative 'that' after a concrete head noun, 'up' in 'up to' after a provision verb, a clause-medial scalar/temporal adverb (finally/never/even/ever/eventually) between subject and verb, an elliptical 'Not' + temporal reply after a speech verb, or modal 'should' after a negated-cognition + subject frame ('don't think we should'). The same surface tokens stay weak outside such frames: 'ch' in church, single-token national, directional particle 'up', complementizer or determiner 'that', integrated 'did/do not' + lexical verb, 'No' + thanks, bare 'we should', or a clause-final adverb.
